objective: Close final-deck correctness, privacy, native parity, and validation reliability blockers without broad architectural refactoring.

required_workstreams.title: native compiler materializer parity
acceptance: Every DRAWINGML_EMITTED plan object has exactly one controlled native materialization record.
Assembler never silently downgrades or skips a plan-declared native object.
Unsupported object families are explicit fallback before materialization.

required_workstreams.title: native style fidelity
acceptance: Supported native style fields are explicitly enumerated.
Geometry, fill, stroke, line width and supported text/font attributes have plan-to-PPTX parity evidence.
Unsupported style or transform semantics become explicit fallback and are not claimed native.

required_workstreams.title: truthful template reconstruction state
acceptance: Release evidence distinguishes fresh sanitized base template from physical professor-template reconstruction.
No full Master/Layout reconstruction is claimed unless physically implemented and validated.

required_workstreams.title: final composition authority
acceptance: Final acceptance-deck slides consume governed placement/composition provenance.
No new final-composition path introduces backend hard-coded geometry that bypasses the governed plan.
Legacy hard-coded branches remain non-authoritative for final production.

required_workstreams.title: bounded SVG fallback and source-tree immutability
acceptance: Broad Exception fallback is removed or bounded to explicit decoder/capability failure.
Compatibility previews are written only to build/temp output locations.
A test proves source and fixture trees remain unchanged after the touched build path.

required_workstreams.title: generated PPTX privacy attestation
acceptance: The base scanner remains fail-closed for PPTX candidates.
Generated PPTX approval requires execution-derived candidate-bound artifact attestation.
Attestation checks approved producer, declared non-private inputs, package lineage, package content privacy, and hashes.
No raw private boundary values are persisted.

performance_quick_wins.title: cache parsed schemas and compiled validators
transactional publication for touched final build paths
validation tiers and test markers or manifest
durable same-candidate full regression runner with optional sharding
ledger materialization optimization
performance_quick_wins.condition: Only if profiling shows it is a material slow-test hot path.

performance_quick_wins.title: synthetic deterministic clock
performance_quick_wins.condition: Defer unless a release-affecting nondeterminism RED test is demonstrated.

validation_policy.sharding_condition: All shards run the same candidate and executed node union equals the authoritative full collection.

deferred: native PowerPoint round-trip when environment remains blocked
stop_conditions: generated PPTX is approved without execution-derived attestation
complete regression collection coverage cannot be proven
unrelated artifacts are modified outside authorized dependency closure
environment limitation would require a fabricated pass
